website.title: Company website
website.text: Your public website: pages of ready-made sections in three templates, in every language you choose.
website.not_started: The website has not been started yet. Start it from the overview.
website.read_only: You can see the website. Owners and sales staff change its pages.
website.owner_only: Only owners change the template, settings and what is published.
website.unsaved_text: Your changes on this screen are not saved yet. They will be lost.
website.no_plans: You have no active plans yet. Make one, then pick it here; names and prices come from the plan.

editor.text: Add, fill in and order the sections of this page. The preview shows the drafts.
editor.missing: This page is not there any more. Back to the
editor.empty: No sections yet. Add the first one.
editor.delete_text: It is removed from the drafts. The live site changes after you publish.

types.hero_slider_text: Big slides at the top that turn by themselves.
types.stats_text: A few figures that count up, some read live.
types.ticker_text: Names sliding by: your modules or your own list.
types.offer_text: A deal with a countdown; hides itself after its end.
types.cards_text: Sectors, solutions or services with an icon.
types.product_text: Your modules in groups: bento, orbit or simple.
types.features_text: Reasons to choose you, beside a panel.
types.partner_text: A strong band with numbered steps.
types.pricing_text: Plans and prices from the plan catalogue.
types.news_text: News and notices with a date.
types.faq_text: Questions and answers, also shown to search engines.
types.cta_text: A closing line with one or two buttons.
types.contact_form_text: Visitors leave their name and phone; you find them under Messages.

fields.title: Title
fields.ask_company: Ask for the company or school
fields.show_contact: Show your phone, email and address beside the form
fields.label: Label
fields.name: Name
fields.caption: Caption
fields.question: Question

leads.text: People who wrote through your website's contact form. Call them soon; mark where each stands.
leads.empty_text: Add a "Contact form" section to a page and publish; what visitors send appears here, and your owners and sales staff get an email.
leads.name: Name
leads.note_hint: Only your staff see it, such as "Demo on Sunday at 11".
leads.remove_text: Their name, phone and message are deleted for good. Do this when they ask, or for spam.

media.title: Website pictures
media.text: Pictures for your sections and for sharing. Uploads are made smaller (WebP), and what the camera hid in them is dropped.
media.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB each; 1600 pixels wide or more looks sharpest.
media.full: This website keeps as many pictures as it may. Remove pictures it no longer uses to upload more.
media.empty_text: Upload your office, team or product pictures, then pick them in a gallery, a slide or a text section.
media.empty_pick: Upload a picture here, or on the Pictures screen.
media.name: Name
media.alt: What the picture shows (read out to people who cannot see it)
media.alt_hint: A few words, such as "Our team at the Dhaka office". Leave empty for a picture that is only decoration.
media.in_use_hint: Used on the website. Take it out of its sections and settings first.
media.remove_text: The picture is deleted for good. It is not used anywhere on the website.
media.too_big: {name} is bigger than {mb} MB. Make it smaller and try again.
media.slide_hint: Shown instead of the drawn picture. A wide picture (about 4:3) fits best.

templates.aurora_text: Dark, glowing, bold — for a tech product.
templates.corporate_text: Light and calm — trusted by businesses.
templates.studio_text: Warm and playful — for a creative brand.

overview.no_address: No public address yet: add a domain that opens your website, and verify it.
overview.publish_first_text: Everyone will see the pages and settings as they are now. You can change them and publish again any time.
overview.publish_text: Visitors will see the pages and settings as they are now. The current version is kept, so you can go back to it.
overview.offline_text: Visitors will see a short "not available" page until you publish again. Nothing is deleted.
overview.restore_text: The website returns to how it was published on {date}, live and in the drafts. Today's version is kept in the history.
overview.start_text: We write the first pages for you — home, pricing, partners and contact — in English and Bangla. Change anything, then publish.
overview.start_ask: Ask an owner or sales staff to start it.
overview.never_published: Visitors see nothing until you publish.
overview.drafts_note: Changes are saved as drafts. Visitors see them after you publish.
overview.template_text: The same pages in a different look. Switching keeps every text.

pages.text: The pages of your website and their order in the menu.
pages.delete_text: The page and its sections ({count}) are deleted from the drafts. The live site changes after you publish.
pages.slug_hint: Small letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. pricing. Changing it later keeps old links working.

seo.title: Search engines
seo.page_hint: Leave empty to use the page name and the site's description.
seo.site_hint: How your website appears on Google and when shared on social media.
seo.image_pick_hint: Shown when the website is shared on social media; 1200 × 630 works best.
seo.image_url: Or the address of a picture
seo.image_hint: An https:// address of a picture, 1200 × 630 works best.
seo.noindex: Hide this page from search engines
seo.verification_hint: Only the code from the meta tag's content.

links.label: Label
links.hint: A page (/pricing), a part of the page (#faq), https://…, mailto:, tel:, or app:/login for your app's address.

settings.text: Colours, menu, notice bar, contact details, footer and search details for the whole website.
settings.check_fields: Some fields need a look. They are marked in red.
settings.colors_hint: Pick a ready set or your own. Empty uses your brand's colours.
settings.main_language_hint: Opens at your address; the others under /bn and so on. Every text needs this language.
settings.menu_hint: Empty shows the pages marked "In the menu".

customize.text: Change the look of your whole website in one place and see it at once: template, slider, product section and colours.
customize.drafts: Changes go to the drafts; visitors see them after Publish.
customize.no_section: Your home page has no {section} section yet.
customize.no_site: Start your website first, then customize it here.
customize.note: Saved to the drafts at once. Logo, texts, menu and more are in
customize.note_writer: Only owners change the template and colours. More in
customize.share_text: A secret link to the public website with this Customize panel, for the person you send it to. They can try the looks; nothing is saved.
customize.share_once: Copy it now: it is shown only once.
customize.share_end_confirm: The person with the link will no longer see the panel.
customize.share_needs_live: Publish the website at its address first; then you can make a look link.
